name: entebharatham
description: EnteBharatham — Ente Bharatham (My India), a community-powered cultural heritage archive to preserve and share India's living cultural heritage.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @entebharatham/shared && npm run build -w @entebharatham/api && npm run build -w @entebharatham/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @entebharatham/shared && npm run typecheck -w @entebharatham/api && npm run typecheck -w @entebharatham/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @entebharatham/shared && npm run test -w @entebharatham/api && npm run test -w @entebharatham/web
